On November 18 2014 the company entered into another collateralised reinsurance agreement with Kilimanjaro Re to provide catastrophe reinsurance coverage.  This agreement covers specified earthquake events and provides up to $500 000 thousand of reinsurance coverage from earthquakes in the United States, Puerto Rico and Canada.

Kilimanjaro Re financed the various property-catastrophe reinsurance coverage by issuing catastrophe bonds to unrelated external investors.
